description_expanded: SummaryEscape to the Caspian Blue Carriage House, a stylish retreat in the sought-after Magnolia Cottages by the Sea neighborhood. This cozy 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom getaway offers modern decor, a well-equipped kitchen, and a spacious living area with a queen sleeper sofa. Just steps from the community pool and a short walk to the deeded beach access, this home is perfect for couples or small families. Rent separately or with the main cottage for larger groups. SpaceEscape to the charming 30A Caspian Blue Carriage House, a beautifully designed retreat nestled in the picturesque Magnolia by the Sea neighborhood. Perfect for a relaxing getaway this one-bedroom one-bathroom homes combines modern luxury with coastal charm. Featuring a full kitchen with a designer tiled bar and backsplash, matte black fixtures and custom made glass cabinet knobs and pulls, every detail has been thoughtfully curated for your comfort. The spacious living area includes a comfortable sleeper sofa for additional guests, making it ideal for a small family. This home also boasts a 10' ceiling, giving the space an open, airy feel. Step outside and take advantage of the community pool, just steps away, or enjoy a day at the beach - both only a short walk or bike ride from your front door. This property is ideal for snowbirds or couples looking for a longer term stay. Your dog is welcome (under 50# on flea and tick preventative, no puppies). Have a large group? Rent with 30A Caspian Blue Cottage which offers the same amenities and sleeps 19! Please note the Carriage House is above the garage and the Main Cottage may be rented to separate groups during your stay. Drive way space may be shared and garage access is included with the Main Cottage only. TRANSPORTATION - Bikes are popular on 30A! 2 are provided with the owners compliments. Should you require additional bikes during your stay, a discount code to a local bike shop will be provided with your arrival information. HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - Large resort style pool (heated depending on ambient nightly temperatures) - Community green space (located at pool) BEACH ACCESS/SERVICE: - There is deeded beach access directly across from the neighborhood. - In order to sit near the access, you must rent a "set" (2 chairs and an umbrella) otherwise you may use the access and walk 2 minutes to the right or 4 minutes to the left to the public access. - Beach Service is provided by a local vendor; information provided upon booking SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 4) - Primary -King bed - Sleeper Sofa - Queen (Living Room) FEATURES: - 1 Bedroom / 1 Bathroom House - Sleeps 4 (King BR, Queen Sleeper Sofa) - Pet Friendly (fee applies) - Beach Chairs, Towels - Gas grill - Huge Screened Porch - Fully Appointed Kitchen - Full Size Refrigerator - Ice Maker - Full Size Stove with Oven - Stackable Washer & Dryer - Complimentary WIFI - Parking for 1 car - Large Resort Style Community Pool only steps away - Close Proximity To The Beach - neighborhood is directly across 30A from beach access - 18 Mile Bike Path Along 30A - Close to The Big Chill, Seaside, Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach This is a strictly non-smoking homeNeighborhoodMagnolia Cottages by the Sea is a small, discreet neighborhood tucked away between Seagrove and Alys Beaches. It is close to everything, but still offers the comforts of a beach vacation coupled with a quiet getaway.AccessGuests can access all of the carriage home and have access to the community pool as well as deeded beach access. Guests are allowed to utilize 2 of the bikes.NotesWe love dogs and are happy to provide a dog friendly space for your vacation (fee applies)! However, it's important to note that dogs are not allowed on any of the beaches along 30A. There is a dog beach at Pier Park located at 16303 Front Beach Rd. Panama City Beach where Fido can meet some new friends and enjoy our gorgeous Emerald Coast! We would like everyone to have a wonderful experience while visiting. Please note that county quiet hours begin at 10pm. A Note on Shared Amenities: Please keep in mind that these spaces are operated by the HOA. Because of this, they are subject to seasonal availability—common seasonal closures may include April-May and Sept-Nov—and we can't be held responsible for unexpected closures or repairs. If you are booking specifically for a shared amenity, please feel free to reach out with any questions in advance!House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are allowed at a fee and with Managers approval . If pets are brought without Manager's knowledge and without paying the pet fee, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 19. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 20. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted. 21. Bicycles must yield to pedestrians when riding on sidewalks. Use designated crosswalks and follow all traffic laws. 22. Helmets are required for riders under 16. Nighttime riding requires a front light and rear reflectors for visibility. 23. Only licensed and insured drivers may operate golf carts and low-speed vehicles (LSVs). 24. Golf carts and LSVs must follow Florida motor vehicle laws and may only be driven on roads with speed limits of 35 mph or less. 25. Golf carts and LSVs may not be driven on sidewalks or bike paths. Working headlights and taillights are required for nighttime use. 26. Bicycles must be locked when parked and marked with identification for return. Guests are responsible for any loss, theft, or damage during the rental. 27. Golf cart and LSV drivers must ensure all passengers wear seatbelts and do not exceed passenger limits. 28. Reckless driving or unauthorized modifications to golf carts and LSVs is prohibited. Park responsibly and return vehicles clean and fully charged or refueled. 29. LSVs and bicycles are not allowed within the Rosemary Beach Community. 30. Guests are responsible for any fines, tickets, or damages incurred during use. Bicycles and golf carts/LSVs must be returned in the same condition as provided. 31. Guests acknowledge the inherent risks of using bicycles and operating golf carts/LSVs. 32. Guests agree to indemnify and hold harmless LocalVR, its owners, and employees from any claims or damages arising from use. 33. LocalVR and the property owner are not liable for injuries or damages incurred, except in cases of gross negligence or willful misconduct.
